# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **M156 platform updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia M156 and broadens native rendering support across desktop platforms. This line adds GTK4 GPU rendering, restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments, and aligns upcoming .NET and native toolchain assets.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone M156** — Moves the bundled renderer to Skia M156 and incorporates the current core-fork cleanup. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — NoDependencies deployments can again locate fonts installed on Linux systems. ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **GTK4 gains native GPU rendering** — Adds GPU-backed rendering and pixel scaling for the GTK4 integration. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Native platform assets refreshed** — Aligns Windows toolchains, Tizen packaging, .NET 11 preview assets, and the WinUI Windows SDK configuration. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306), [#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238), [#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235), [#5273](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5273))
